_meta.purpose: Models shown in the Full table and the Highlights KPI strip / efficiency frontier. Anything evaluated but not listed here is hidden from those views.
_meta.not_applied_to: The Trends tab. Trends intentionally show the FULL history, including retired models -- do not filter it.
_meta.keys: org/model, matching EvalResult.full_model. Matched case-insensitively, whitespace-trimmed.
_meta.source_of_truth: Hand-maintained mirror of scripts/daily_eval.sh MODELS (argo:* names resolved through dataset/model_map.json) and scripts/alcf_Eval.sh MODELS. Update this file whenever either roster changes -- nothing does it automatically.
_meta.on_error: Missing, unparseable, or empty -> NO filtering (fail open), with a WARNING in the Space log. A typo must never blank the leaderboard.
